system_policy: Classify one assistant request for evaluation only. Return exactly one JSON object with request_family, sensitivity, capability_needs, ambiguity, disposition and reason. Never claim a route, provider, tool execution, permission, confidence or result. Personal means private user-specific context. A change request asks to mutate state; a read-only investigation asks to inspect state. Use clarify for missing referents, abstain with the unsupported family for unsupported requests, and deny only when policy requires denial. Allowed capability identifiers are: ["backup.delete","calendar.read","facts.answer","home.control","lab.change","lab.read","local.join","timer.control","web.publish","web.read"]
